prompt:
Create ONE original wooden dining table asset for the cozy farming RPG Simple Life.
REFERENCE GUIDANCE: image 1 (outdoor town) is visual guidance for clean pixel clusters, warm outlines, readable shapes and LOW top-down perspective. Image 2 (indoor room) is guidance for adult furniture proportions, warm wood colours, pottery details and restrained material shading. Do not copy any sprite, scene or layout.
ART STYLE: Clean handcrafted pixel art for a welcoming village game. Warm walnut brown, cream, terracotta, subtle muted accents. Clear intentional pixel clusters. Approximately 3–4 shades per material, thin DARK BROWN outlines (not heavy black), consistent upper-left lighting, softened outlines on lit edges. Restrained texture: just a few wood-grain marks and plank seams. NO dense speckling, random noisy pixels, excessive weathering, gothic/horror mood or painterly shading.
PERSPECTIVE AND STRUCTURE: Match the references' LOW top-down THREE-QUARTER view. Show the oval tabletop upper plane, the tabletop thickness, a short front apron and convincingly attached sturdy wooden legs. Width axis horizontal; upright legs vertical. Consistent single camera, not steep overhead flat plan view and not eye-level front view. Appropriate for adult village characters.
OBJECT DESIGN: One simple oval walnut dining table with sturdy wooden legs. Exactly ONE small cream ceramic JUG with a distinct handle and mouth and exactly TWO modest TERRACOTTA CUPS, visibly separated and easy to recognize. No plates, flowers, books or other clutter. Gentle handmade details, quiet uncluttered tabletop.
OUTPUT: One isolated COMPLETE centered table with transparent padding on all sides; all feet included. TRUE transparent PNG RGBA background and open gaps under the tabletop. Target native sprite about 128x80 pixels, consistent square pixel grid, enlarged nearest-neighbor hard edges, recognizable details at gameplay size. No characters, room, floor, walls, scenery, ground shadow, labels, text, watermark, blur, smooth gradients, anti-aliasing or unrelated objects.
